per_question.question: ¿Qué pacientes han tenido un ingreso dentro de los tres meses posteriores a un recambio de cadera o rodilla?
agent_sqls:
WITH procedimientos AS (
    -- Episodio con recambio de cadera o rodilla
    SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_ref, p.episode_ref, p.start_date AS fecha_procedimiento, p.descr AS procedimiento
    FROM g_procedures p
    WHERE p.code LIKE '81.5%'
       OR p.code LIKE '0SR9%'
       OR p.code LIKE '0SRB%'
       OR p.code LIKE '0SRE%'
       OR p.code LIKE '0SRA%'
       OR p.code LIKE '0SRR%'
       OR p.code LIKE '0SRC%'
       OR p.code LIKE '0SRD%'
       OR p.code LIKE '0SRW%'
),
ingresos AS (
    SELECT e.patient_ref, e.episode_ref, e.start_date AS fecha_ingreso, e.end_date
    FROM g_episodes e
    WHERE e.episode_type_ref = 'HOSP'
)
SELECT DISTINCT
    pr.patient_ref,
    pr.episode_ref        AS episodio_procedimiento,
    pr.procedimiento,
    pr.fecha_procedimiento,
    ing.episode_ref       AS episodio_ingreso,
    ing.fecha_ingreso,
    DATEDIFF(ing.fecha_ingreso, pr.fecha_procedimiento) AS dias_hasta_ingreso
FROM procedimientos pr
JOIN ingresos ing
    ON ing.patient_ref = pr.patient_ref
    -- El ingreso es posterior al procedimiento y dentro de los 3 meses (90 días)
    AND ing.fecha_ingreso > pr.fecha_procedimiento
    AND DATEDIFF(ing.fecha_ingreso, pr.fecha_procedimiento) <= 90
    -- El ingreso no es el mismo episodio que el del procedimiento
    AND ing.episode_ref <> pr.episode_ref
ORDER BY pr.patient_ref, pr.fecha_procedimiento, ing.fecha_ingreso

WITH recambios AS (
    -- Procedimientos de recambio/sustitución de cadera o rodilla
    SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_ref, p.episode_ref, p.start_date AS proc_date, p.descr AS proc_descr
    FROM g_procedures p
    WHERE
        -- Cadera (ICD-9 y ICD-10)
        p.code IN ('81.51','81.52','81.53')
        OR p.code LIKE '0SR9%' OR p.code LIKE '0SRB%' OR p.code LIKE '0SRR%'
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRA%' OR p.code LIKE '0SRE%'
        -- Rodilla (ICD-9 y ICD-10)
        OR p.code IN ('81.54','81.55')
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRC%' OR p.code LIKE '0SRD%' OR p.code LIKE '0SRW%'
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRT%'
),
reingresos AS (
    -- Ingresos posteriores dentro de los 3 meses siguientes al procedimiento
    SELECT
        r.patient_ref,
        r.proc_date,
        r.proc_descr,
        e.episode_ref   AS reingreso_episode_ref,
        e.start_date    AS reingreso_fecha,
        DATEDIFF(e.start_date, r.proc_date) AS dias_hasta_reingreso
    FROM recambios r
    JOIN g_episodes e
        ON e.patient_ref = r.patient_ref
        AND e.episode_type_ref = 'HOSP'
        AND e.start_date > r.proc_date
        AND e.start_date <= DATE_ADD(r.proc_date, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
        AND e.episode_ref <> r.episode_ref   -- excluir el mismo episodio del procedimiento
)
SELECT
    ri.patient_ref,
    d.birth_date,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, d.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS edad,
    CASE d.sex WHEN 1 THEN 'Hombre' WHEN 2 THEN 'Mujer' ELSE 'Desconocido' END AS sexo,
    ri.proc_descr                   AS procedimiento,
    ri.proc_date                    AS fecha_procedimiento,
    ri.reingreso_episode_ref,
    ri.reingreso_fecha,
    ri.dias_hasta_reingreso
FROM reingresos ri
JOIN g_demographics d ON d.patient_ref = ri.patient_ref
ORDER BY ri.patient_ref, ri.proc_date, ri.reingreso_fecha;

WITH procedimientos AS (
    -- Recambio/sustitución de cadera o rodilla
    SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_ref, p.episode_ref, p.start_date AS fecha_procedimiento, p.descr AS procedimiento
    FROM g_procedures p
    WHERE 
        p.code IN ('81.51','81.52','81.53','81.54','81.55')
        OR p.code LIKE '0SR9%' OR p.code LIKE '0SRB%' OR p.code LIKE '0SRR%'
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRA%' OR p.code LIKE '0SRE%'
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRC%' OR p.code LIKE '0SRD%' OR p.code LIKE '0SRW%'
        OR p.code LIKE '0SRT%'
),
reingresos AS (
    -- Ingresos posteriores dentro de los 3 meses
    SELECT 
        pr.patient_ref,
        pr.episode_ref        AS episode_procedimiento,
        pr.fecha_procedimiento,
        pr.procedimiento,
        e.episode_ref         AS episode_reingreso,
        e.start_date          AS fecha_reingreso,
        DATEDIFF(e.start_date, pr.fecha_procedimiento) AS dias_hasta_reingreso
    FROM procedimientos pr
    JOIN g_episodes e 
        ON e.patient_ref = pr.patient_ref
        AND e.episode_type_ref = 'HOSP'
        AND e.start_date > pr.fecha_procedimiento
        AND e.start_date <= DATE_ADD(pr.fecha_procedimiento, INTERVAL 3 MONTH)
        AND e.episode_ref <> pr.episode_ref   -- excluir el mismo episodio
)
SELECT 
    r.patient_ref,
    d.birth_date,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, d.birth_date, CURDATE()) AS edad,
    CASE d.sex WHEN 1 THEN 'Hombre' WHEN 2 THEN 'Mujer' ELSE 'Desconocido' END AS sexo,
    r.procedimiento,
    r.fecha_procedimiento,
    r.episode_procedimiento,
    r.episode_reingreso,
    r.fecha_reingreso,
    r.dias_hasta_reingreso
FROM reingresos r
JOIN g_demographics d ON d.patient_ref = r.patient_ref
ORDER BY r.patient_ref, r.fecha_procedimiento, r.fecha_reingreso;

per_question.question: En pacientes con diagnóstico de glaucoma, ¿qué procedimientos quirúrgicos relacionados con glaucoma han sido realizados y cuándo ocurrieron en relación con el diagnóstico?

WITH diag_glaucoma AS (
    -- Diagnóstico de glaucoma por paciente (primer diagnóstico)
    SELECT
        patient_ref,
        MIN(diag_date) AS primera_fecha_diagnostico
    FROM g_diagnostics
    WHERE code LIKE 'H40%'
    GROUP BY patient_ref
),
proc_glaucoma AS (
    -- Procedimientos quirúrgicos relacionados con glaucoma
    SELECT
        p.patient_ref,
        p.episode_ref,
        p.code AS proc_code,
        p.descr AS proc_descr,
        p.start_date AS fecha_procedimiento
    FROM g_procedures p
    WHERE p.code IN ('12.64', '12.65', '12.67')
)
SELECT
    pg.patient_ref,
    dg.primera_fecha_diagnostico,
    pg.fecha_procedimiento,
    pg.proc_code,
    TRIM(pg.proc_descr) AS procedimiento,
    DATEDIFF(pg.fecha_procedimiento, dg.primera_fecha_diagnostico) AS dias_desde_diagnostico,
    CASE
        WHEN pg.fecha_procedimiento < dg.primera_fecha_diagnostico THEN 'ANTES del diagnóstico'
        WHEN pg.fecha_procedimiento = dg.primera_fecha_diagnostico THEN 'MISMO DÍA del diagnóstico'
        ELSE CONCAT('DESPUÉS del diagnóstico (+', DATEDIFF(pg.fecha_procedimiento, dg.primera_fecha_diagnostico), ' días)')
    END AS relacion_temporal
FROM proc_glaucoma pg
INNER JOIN diag_glaucoma dg ON pg.patient_ref = dg.patient_ref
ORDER BY pg.patient_ref, pg.fecha_procedimiento

WITH glaucoma_diag AS (
    SELECT
        d.patient_ref,
        d.episode_ref,
        d.diag_date,
        d.code AS diag_code,
        d.diag_descr
    FROM g_diagnostics d
    WHERE d.code LIKE 'H40%'
),
glaucoma_proc AS (
    SELECT
        p.patient_ref,
        p.episode_ref,
        p.start_date AS proc_date,
        p.code AS proc_code,
        p.descr AS proc_descr
    FROM g_procedures p
    WHERE p.code IN ('12.64', '12.65')
)
SELECT
    gd.patient_ref,
    gd.diag_code,
    gd.diag_descr,
    DATE(gd.diag_date) AS fecha_diagnostico,
    gp.proc_code,
    TRIM(gp.proc_descr) AS procedimiento,
    DATE(gp.proc_date) AS fecha_procedimiento,
    DATEDIFF(gp.proc_date, gd.diag_date) AS dias_desde_diagnostico,
    CASE
        WHEN DATEDIFF(gp.proc_date, gd.diag_date) < 0 THEN 'ANTES del diagnóstico'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(gp.proc_date, gd.diag_date) = 0 THEN 'MISMO DÍA que el diagnóstico'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(gp.proc_date, gd.diag_date) BETWEEN 1 AND 30 THEN 'Dentro del primer mes'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(gp.proc_date, gd.diag_date) BETWEEN 31 AND 180 THEN 'Entre 1 y 6 meses después'
        WHEN DATEDIFF(gp.proc_date, gd.diag_date) BETWEEN 181 AND 365 THEN 'Entre 6 y 12 meses después'
        ELSE 'Más de 1 año después'
    END AS relacion_temporal
FROM glaucoma_diag gd
JOIN glaucoma_proc gp ON gd.patient_ref = gp.patient_ref
ORDER BY gd.patient_ref, gp.proc_date

    SELECT

        p.descr AS proc_descr,

    FROM g_procedures p
    WHERE p.code IN ('12.64', '12.65', '12.67')
)
SELECT
    pg.patient_ref,
    dg.primera_fecha_diagnostico,
    pg.fecha_procedimiento,
    pg.proc_code,
    TRIM(pg.proc_descr) AS procedimiento,
    DATEDIFF(pg.fecha_procedimiento, dg.primera_fecha_diagnostico) AS dias_desde_diagnostico,
    CASE
        WHEN pg.fecha_procedimiento < dg.primera_fecha_diagnostico THEN 'ANTES del diagnóstico'
        WHEN pg.fecha_procedimiento = dg.primera_fecha_diagnostico THEN 'MISMO DÍA del diagnóstico'
        ELSE CONCAT(DATEDIFF(pg.fecha_procedimiento, dg.primera_fecha_diagnostico), ' días DESPUÉS del diagnóstico')

per_question.question: ¿Cuáles son los valores máximo y mínimo de creatinina encontrados, por cada subtipo de enfermedad renal crónica, en pacientes de entre 50 y 70 años?
agent_sqls:
WITH pacientes_erc AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.patient_ref, d.diag_descr, d.code
    FROM g_diagnostics d
    JOIN g_demographics dem ON dem.patient_ref = d.patient_ref
    WHERE (d.code LIKE 'N18%' OR d.code LIKE 'I12%' OR d.code LIKE 'I13%')
      AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, dem.birth_date, CURDATE()) BETWEEN 50 AND 70
)
SELECT
    p.code                          AS codigo_icd,
    p.diag_descr                    AS subtipo_erc,
    MAX(l.result_num)               AS creatinina_max,
    MIN(l.result_num)               AS creatinina_min,
    COUNT(DISTINCT l.patient_ref)   AS num_pacientes
FROM pacientes_erc p
JOIN g_labs l ON l.patient_ref = p.patient_ref
WHERE l.lab_sap_ref IN ('LAB2467', 'LABOCREA', 'LABCREAAR')

Para cada estancia incluye: identificación del paciente y episodio, identificador de estancia, unidad asignada, fechas de ingreso y alta (real y efectiva), duración (horas, días y minutos), indicador de si sigue ingresado, número de movimientos y unidades visitadas, minutos en E073 y minutos en I073, indicador de transferencia, año de ingreso, edad al ingreso, sexo, indicador de éxitus durante la estancia y fecha del éxitus, procedencia (formulario UCI) e indicador de procedencia de otro centro. eps_base AS (
    SELECT e.episode_ref, e.patient_ref, e.start_date, e.end_date

    WHERE e.episode_type_ref = 'HOSP'

),
-- Movimientos en E073 o I073 (sin filtro de care_level_type_ref)
mov_target AS (
    SELECT
        m.episode_ref,
        m.patient_ref,
        m.ou_loc_ref,
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, m.start_date, COALESCE(m.end_date, NOW())) AS minutos
    FROM g_movements m
    INNER JOIN eps_base eb ON eb.episode_ref = m.episode_ref AND eb.patient_ref = m.patient_ref
    WHERE m.ou_loc_ref IN ('E073','I073')
),
eps_con_target AS (

),
unidad_pred AS (

        COALESCE(me.min_e073, 0) AS min_e073,

        CASE

    FROM eps_con_target ec

-- Verificar que tienen al menos un movimiento con cama real (cualquier ou_loc_ref con care_level_type_ref no nulo)

WITH 
-- Episodios HOSP/HOSP_IQ de 2023 con al menos un movimiento en E073 o I073 (cama real = ICU, que es el care_level de estas unidades)

    SELECT DISTINCT e.patient_ref, e.episode_ref
    FROM g_episodes e
    JOIN g_movements m ON m.patient_ref = e.patient_ref AND m.episode_ref = e.episode_ref
    WHERE e.episode_type_ref IN ('HOSP','HOSP_IQ')
      AND YEAR(e.start_date) = 2023
      AND m.ou_loc_ref IN ('E073','I073')
      AND m.care_level_type_ref = 'ICU'
),
-- Solo episodios con al menos una prescripción activa durante la estancia
eps_with_rx AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT eb.patient_ref, eb.episode_ref
    FROM eps_base eb
    JOIN g_prescriptions p  ON p.patient_ref  = eb.patient_ref AND p.episode_ref = eb.episode_ref
    JOIN g_episodes e       ON e.patient_ref  = eb.patient_ref AND e.episode_ref = eb.episode_ref
    WHERE p.start_drug_date <= COALESCE(e.end_date, NOW())
      AND (p.end_drug_date IS NULL OR p.end_drug_date >= e.start_date)
),
-- Todos los movimientos del episodio
movs AS (
    SELECT 
        m.patient_ref,
        m.episode_ref,
        m.ou_loc_ref,
        m.ou_med_ref,
        m.start_date                                                        AS mov_start,
        m.end_date                                                          AS mov_end,
        m.care_level_type_ref,
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, m.start_date, COALESCE(m.end_date, NOW()))   AS mov_minutes
    FROM g_movements m
    JOIN eps_with_rx er ON er.patient_ref = m.patient_ref AND er.episode_ref = m.episode_ref
),
-- Tiempo total por unidad por episodio
unit_time AS (
    SELECT 
        patient_ref,
        episode_ref,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ou_loc_ref = 'E073' THEN mov_minutes ELSE 0 END)     AS min_e073,
        SUM(CASE WHEN ou_loc_ref = 'I073' THEN mov_minutes ELSE 0 END)     AS min_i073,
        COUNT(*)                                                            AS num_movimientos,
        COUNT(DISTINCT ou_loc_ref)                                          AS num_unidades
    FROM movs
    GROUP BY patient_ref, episode_ref
),
-- Unidad predominante entre E073 e I073
unit_pred AS (
    SELECT 
        patient_ref,
        episode_ref,
        CASE WHEN min_e073 >= min_i073 THEN 'E073' ELSE 'I073' END         AS unidad_predominante
    FROM unit_time
),
-- Indicador de transferencia: ¿hubo movimiento en otra unidad ANTES del primer movimiento en E073/I073?
first_target AS (

    FROM movs
    WHERE ou_loc_ref IN ('E073','I073')
    GROUP BY patient_ref, episode_ref
),
transfer_flag AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT m.patient_ref, m.episode_ref, 1 AS es_traslado
    FROM movs m
    JOIN first_target ft ON ft.patient_ref = m.patient_ref AND ft.episode_ref = m.episode_ref
    WHERE m.ou_loc_ref NOT IN ('E073','I073')
      AND m.mov_start < ft.first_target_mov
),
-- Procedencia UCI (formulario valoracion criticos)
proc_uci AS (
    SELECT 
        df.patient_ref,
        df.episode_ref,
        MAX(df.value_descr)                                                 AS procedencia_uci
    FROM g_dynamic_forms df

      AND df.question_descr LIKE '%procedencia del paciente antes del ingreso hospitalario%'

-- QUERY PRINCIPAL
SELECT
    -- Identificación
    e.patient_ref                                                           AS id_paciente,
    e.episode_ref                                                           AS id_episodio,
    CONCAT(e.patient_ref, '-', e.episode_ref)                              AS id_estancia,
    up.unidad_predominante                                                  AS unidad_asignada,

    -- Fechas de ingreso y alta
    e.start_date                                                            AS fecha_ingreso,
    e.end_date                                                              AS fecha_alta_real,
    COALESCE(e.end_date, NOW())                                             AS fecha_alta_efectiva,

    -- Duración

    TIMESTAMPDIFF(DAY,    e.start_date, COALESCE(e.end_date, NOW()))       AS duracion_dias,
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, e.start_date, COALESCE(e.end_date, NOW()))       AS duracion_minutos,

    -- Indicador sigue ingresado
    CASE WHEN e.end_date IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END                         AS sigue_ingresado,

    -- Movimientos y unidades
    ut.num_movimientos,
    ut.num_unidades                                                         AS num_unidades_visitadas,

    -- Minutos en E073 e I073
    ut.min_e073                                                             AS minutos_e073,
    ut.min_i073                                                             AS minutos_i073,

    -- Indicador de transferencia
    CASE WHEN tf.es_traslado = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END                        AS indicador_transferencia,

    -- Año de ingreso
    YEAR(e.start_date)                                                      AS anio_ingreso,

    -- Edad al ingreso
    TIMESTAMPDIFF(YEAR, d.birth_date, e.start_date)                        AS edad_al_ingreso,

    -- Sexo (1=hombre, 2=mujer)
    d.sex                                                                   AS sexo,

    -- Éxitus durante la estancia
    CASE 
        WHEN ex.exitus_date >= e.start_date 
         AND ex.exitus_date <= COALESCE(e.end_date, NOW()) 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END                                                                     AS exitus_durante_estancia,
    CASE 
        WHEN ex.exitus_date >= e.start_date 
         AND ex.exitus_date <= COALESCE(e.end_date, NOW()) 
        THEN ex.exitus_date ELSE NULL 
    END                                                                     AS fecha_exitus,

    -- Procedencia (formulario valoracion criticos / UCI)
    pu.procedencia_uci                                                      AS procedencia_uci,

    -- Indicador procedencia otro centro
    CASE 
        WHEN pu.procedencia_uci LIKE '%ospital%'
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 
    END                                                                     AS procedencia_otro_centro

FROM g_episodes e
JOIN eps_with_rx er   ON er.patient_ref = e.patient_ref AND er.episode_ref = e.episode_ref
JOIN unit_time  ut    ON ut.patient_ref = e.patient_ref AND ut.episode_ref = e.episode_ref
JOIN unit_pred  up    ON up.patient_ref = e.patient_ref AND up.episode_ref = e.episode_ref
JOIN g_demographics d ON d.patient_ref = e.patient_ref
LEFT JOIN transfer_flag tf ON tf.patient_ref = e.patient_ref AND tf.episode_ref = e.episode_ref
LEFT JOIN g_exitus      ex ON ex.patient_ref = e.patient_ref
LEFT JOIN proc_uci      pu ON pu.patient_ref = e.patient_ref AND pu.episode_ref = e.episode_ref

WITH 
-- Episodios HOSP del año 2023
eps AS (
    SELECT 
        e.patient_ref,
        e.episode_ref,
        e.start_date   AS fecha_ingreso,
        e.end_date     AS fecha_alta_real,
        e.episode_type_ref
    FROM g_episodes e
    WHERE e.episode_type_ref IN ('HOSP','HOSP_IQ')
      AND YEAR(e.start_date) = 2023
),

-- Movimientos con cama real (WARD o ICU) — excluye virtuales/pendientes
mov_real AS (
    SELECT 
        m.patient_ref,
        m.episode_ref,
        m.ou_loc_ref,
        m.ou_med_ref,
        m.ou_med_descr,
        m.care_level_type_ref,
        m.start_date                                                AS mov_start,
        m.end_date                                                  AS mov_end,
        TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, m.start_date, COALESCE(m.end_date, NOW())) AS minutos_mov
    FROM g_movements m
    WHERE m.care_level_type_ref IN ('WARD','ICU')
),

-- Minutos totales por episodio en E073 y en I073
min_e073 AS (
    SELECT mr.patient_ref, mr.episode_ref,
           SUM(mr.minutos_mov) AS minutos_e073
    FROM mov_real mr
    WHERE mr.ou_loc_ref = 'E073'
    GROUP BY mr.patient_ref, mr.episode_ref
),
min_i073 AS (
    SELECT mr.patient_ref, mr.episode_ref,
           SUM(mr.minutos_mov) AS minutos_i073
    FROM mov_real mr
    WHERE mr.ou_loc_ref = 'I073'
    GROUP BY mr.patient_ref, mr.episode_ref
),

-- Unidad predominante (E073 vs I073) — solo episodios con al menos E073
unidad_predominante AS (
    SELECT 
        e073.patient_ref,
        e073.episode_ref,
        COALESCE(e073.minutos_e073, 0)  AS minutos_e073,
        COALESCE(i073.minutos_i073, 0)  AS minutos_i073,
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(e073.minutos_e073, 0) >= COALESCE(i073.minutos_i073, 0) THEN 'E073'
            ELSE 'I073'
        END AS unidad_asignada
    FROM min_e073 e073
    LEFT JOIN min_i073 i073 
        ON e073.patient_ref = i073.patient_ref 
       AND e073.episode_ref = i073.episode_ref
    UNION
    SELECT 
        i073.patient_ref,
        i073.episode_ref,
        COALESCE(e073.minutos_e073, 0)  AS minutos_e073,
        COALESCE(i073.minutos_i073, 0)  AS minutos_i073,
        CASE 
            WHEN COALESCE(e073.minutos_e073, 0) >= COALESCE(i073.minutos_i073, 0) THEN 'E073'
            ELSE 'I073'
        END AS unidad_asignada
    FROM min_i073 i073
    LEFT JOIN min_e073 e073 
        ON i073.patient_ref = e073.patient_ref 
       AND i073.episode_ref = e073.episode_ref
),

-- Solo episodios predominantemente E073
eps_predominante_e073 AS (
    SELECT up.patient_ref, up.episode_ref, up.minutos_e073, up.minutos_i073, up.unidad_asignada
    FROM unidad_predominante up
    WHERE up.unidad_asignada = 'E073'
),

-- Base: HOSP 2023 + predominante E073
base AS (
    SELECT 
        e.patient_ref,
        e.episode_ref,
        e.fecha_ingreso,
        e.fecha_alta_real,
        up.unidad_asignada,
        up.minutos_e073,
        up.minutos_i073
    FROM eps e
    INNER JOIN eps_predominante_e073 up 
        ON e.patient_ref = up.patient_ref 
       AND e.episode_ref = up.episode_ref
),

-- Filtro: al menos una prescripción activa durante la estancia
eps_con_prescripcion AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT p.patient_ref, p.episode_ref
    FROM g_prescriptions p
    INNER JOIN base b 
        ON p.patient_ref = b.patient_ref 
       AND p.episode_ref = b.episode_ref
),

-- Filtro: al menos un movimiento con cama real en el episodio
eps_con_cama AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT mr.patient_ref, mr.episode_ref
    FROM mov_real mr
    INNER JOIN base b 
        ON mr.patient_ref = b.patient_ref 
       AND mr.episode_ref = b.episode_ref
),

-- Estadísticas de movimientos por episodio (todos los movimientos del episodio)
mov_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        m.patient_ref,
        m.episode_ref,
        COUNT(*)                                                    AS num_movimientos,
        COUNT(DISTINCT m.ou_loc_ref)                                AS num_unidades_visitadas,
        MAX(CASE WHEN m.ou_loc_ref NOT IN ('E073','I073') 
                  AND m.care_level_type_ref IN ('WARD','ICU')
                 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)                                 AS ind_transferencia
    FROM g_movements m
    INNER JOIN base b 
        ON m.patient_ref = b.patient_ref 
       AND m.episode_ref = b.episode_ref
    GROUP BY m.patient_ref, m.episode_ref
),

-- Fecha alta efectiva (fin del último movimiento con cama real)
fecha_alta_efectiva AS (
    SELECT mr.patient_ref, mr.episode_ref,
           MAX(mr.mov_end) AS fecha_alta_efectiva
    FROM mov_real mr
    INNER JOIN base b 
        ON mr.patient_ref = b.patient_ref 
       AND mr.episode_ref = b.episode_ref
    GROUP BY mr.patient_ref, mr.episode_ref
),

-- Éxitus durante la estancia
exitus_estancia AS (
    SELECT 
        b.patient_ref,
        b.episode_ref,
        ex.exitus_date
    FROM base b
    INNER JOIN g_exitus ex ON ex.patient_ref = b.patient_ref
    WHERE ex.exitus_date BETWEEN b.fecha_ingreso AND COALESCE(b.fecha_alta_real, NOW())
),

-- Procedencia (formulario valoracion criticos / valoracion hospitalizacion)
procedencia_form AS (
    SELECT 
        df.patient_ref,
        df.episode_ref,
        MAX(df.value_descr)                                         AS procedencia_formulario,
        MAX(CASE WHEN df.value_descr IN ('Otro hospital','Altre hospital') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ind_otro_centro
    FROM g_dynamic_forms df
    INNER JOIN base b 
        ON df.patient_ref = b.patient_ref 
       AND df.episode_ref = b.episode_ref
    WHERE df.form_descr IN ('valoracion criticos\n','valoracion hospitalizacion\n')
      AND df.question_descr = 'procedencia del paciente antes del ingreso hospitalario'
    GROUP BY df.patient_ref, df.episode_ref
)

-- QUERY FINAL

    b.unidad_asignada,

    SELECT

        m.end_date,
        m.ou_loc_ref,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.patient_ref, m.episode_ref ORDER BY m.start_date) AS rn
    FROM g_movements m
    WHERE m.ou_loc_ref IN ('E016','E103','E014','E015','E037','E057','E073','E043')
      AND m.start_date >= '2023-01-01'
      AND m.start_date <  '2024-01-01'
      AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(MINUTE, m.start_date, m.end_date) > 60  -- duración > 1 hora

        m.start_date,
        m.end_date,

    FROM movimientos m

),

    SELECT
        patient_ref,
        episode_ref,
        start_date,
        end_date,
        ou_loc_ref
    FROM movimientos_con_siguiente
    WHERE next_start_date IS NULL
       OR end_date <> next_start_date
